body: An affiliate of Criterion Real Estate Capital, the noteholder, filed a foreclosure notice on Monday, September 28, 2026 for 450 Fifth St. NW, a large Brutalist office building near Judiciary Square in Washington, D.C., the Washington Business Journal reported, according to Connect CRE. The notice says the owner, Judiciary Plaza LLC, owes $166.6 million on a $177.5 million note from 2007.

The 539,478-square-foot building was scheduled for an October 28, 2026 foreclosure auction at the D.C. office of Alex Cooper Auctioneers. The report described the building as slated for conversion into 500 residential units.

timeline.label: The $177.5M note secured by 450 Fifth St. NW is originated
Criterion affiliate files a foreclosure notice against Judiciary Plaza LLC, setting an October 28 auction
